statement: No non-Production Masaarat capture session has been authorized for controlled-v1. MASAARAT_SCREENSHOT cells require a real, authenticated, non-Production Masaarat learner/admin session (e.g. a staging or seeded QA account) explicitly authorized by Control Room for screenshot capture; none currently exists.
consequence: Every MASAARAT_SCREENSHOT cell in PRODUCTION_MANIFEST.json and PILOT_MANIFEST.json routes through src/lib/lesson-visuals/controlled-v1/routes/masaaratScreenshot.ts, which fails closed to status BLOCKED_UNRESOLVED_SPEC whenever no capture session config file exists under this capture/ directory.
howToAuthorizeCapture: To unblock a specific cell, a Control-Room-approved capture config file must be added at docs/lesson-visuals/controlled-v1/capture/{lessonId}__{locale}.capture.json (or docs/lesson-visuals/controlled-v1/capture/{lessonId}.capture.json to cover all locales) matching the schema documented in src/lib/lesson-visuals/controlled-v1/routes/masaaratScreenshot.ts, pointing at a non-Production environment/session. No such file currently exists for any lesson.
